The woman on the left has long dark braids, wears black-rimmed glasses, a white cardigan over a blue shirt, a blue plaid skirt, and white knee-high socks. The woman on the right has short dark hair, wearing a black sailor-style school uniform with a red bow and white ankle socks. They face the camera with friendly expressions against a background of a traditional Japanese wooden house and lush green trees. (2) They perform a synchronized dance routine involving precise hand gestures. They tap their heads with both hands simultaneously, then point towards the camera and each other in a rhythmic pattern. A black van is parked behind them on the right side of the frame, and distant mountains are visible under a bright, clear sky. The lighting is natural and intense, casting soft shadows on the pavement. (3) The dance concludes with a high-energy movement where they jump slightly and strike a wide, celebratory pose. Both women are smiling broadly, showing joy and coordination. The woman on the left lifts one leg in a playful manner. The camera remains static throughout the take, capturing the full bodies of both subjects in a medium full shot.
